proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.spawned_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is an activated magic item that creates a controllable creature with duration, revert triggers, and recharge timing. Those shapes exist only for spell mechanics today.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you take a Magic action to throw the figurine ... the figurine becomes a living creature ... The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.variant_roster
proposed_widenings.justification: The named SRD unit is a family of distinct figurines with different rarity, creature form, cooldown, and extra riders. A single MagicItemRecord cannot honestly represent 'rarity varies' plus the per-figurine descriptions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Bronze Griffon (Rare) ... Ebony Fly (Rare) ... Obsidian Steed (Very Rare) ... Silver Raven (Uncommon).

notes: Stopped before authoring placeholder content. The current surface can encode spawned companions for spells, but not for magic items, and this SRD entry is an umbrella collection rather than one uniform item.
